messages:
jamal: hey all, first day here! quick mapping Qs: who owns quota/billing for dedicated GPUs, who approves dataset use for evals, and who do I ping to get a perf slot booked? also where are the repo OWNERS for infra services?
gina (people-ops): welcome jamal :wave: short list: billing/quotas -> finance + eng-infra (@alex). dataset/legal -> security -> legal (open security intake). perf/hardware booking -> eng-infra bookings board or DM @alex. OWNERS -> repo root/OWNERS or owners-index page. i'll DM you a concise contact card.
alex (eng-infra): hi jamal. for GPU quotas file capacity request with model, qps, p99 target, expected duration. finance approves billing codes, infra schedules the nodes. for perf slot include region/GPU type and preferred dates. OWNERS are per-service - run `git ls-files | rg OWNERS` to list.
mira (eng-ml): for eval datasets ping #eng-ml with dataset id + intended labeling. if human reviewers or annotators involved we require DPA + security intake first. model-onboard issues should include sample prompts, expected eval metrics, and a perf budget. team-models will triage within 48h.
sec-bot: security intake created? If not, start at https://internal/security/intake. High-risk data requires explicit approval before access.
jamal: perfect, thanks. one more: who do I shadow for oncall basics?
gina (people-ops): shadow SRE rotation; i'll set up Tue/Thu 2-hr pairing with the oncall and a 30m runbook walkthrough. prefer calendar invites?
jamal: calendar invites please. thanks everyone!
